summary_en: Current ROE –40.7% (FY3/26), PBR 0.75x; cost of capital 5.17%. Targets: PBR >1.0, ROE 10%+. Dividend policy shift FY3/27: DOE 3.0% basis, semi-annual (interim+final) vs. annual. Actions: domestic profitability (store restructuring, cost control); China optimization (asset transfers, concentration); IR expansion.
title_en: Management Initiatives to Realize Capital-Cost- and Stock-Price-Aware Operations
translation_en_brief: On 23 June 2026, Ichikura's board resolved a comprehensive capital-cost management framework. Current status: ROE fell to –40.7% in FY3/26 (after two successive loss years), PBR stands at 0.75x (below 1.0), and the company's estimated cost of capital is 5.17%. The board identified three structural issues: declining capital returns (ROE), weak market valuation (PBR), and deteriorating domestic profitability (sales down since FY3/24, SG&A ratio rising). Target metrics: achieve PBR >1.0 and ROE 10%+ through sustained capital-cost management. Specific initiatives: (1) domestic business optimization (kimono: store closure/rebuild, advertising cost control; wedding: new styles, new photo studio); (2) China restructuring (cost reduction, asset sale of Shanghai Hongqiao location, concentration at Daning); (3) dividend policy realignment effective FY3/27—shift from stable annual dividend to semi-annual payout based on 3.0% DOE; (4) enhanced IR (investor events, one-on-one meetings, mid-term plan disclosure planned Q3 FY3/27).
